Back's a good one to specialize on — it responds fast to volume if you row and pull consistently. Mix of horizontal pulling (rows) and vertical pulling (pull-ups, lat pulldowns) covers it, with deadlifts or RDLs for the lower back and posterior chain. Most people make more progress adding a day of back work per week than tweaking exercises endlessly.

If you want, I can build you a block that leans extra volume into back — just say the word and I'll set it up as a patch for you to confirm.
